headline: A governed context layer can carry approved evidence into bounded delivery tasks.
subtitle: Link source-backed findings and business process context so each team can retrieve what its work requires.
source_1_body: Application components, interfaces, data, controls, dependencies, source links, and confidence.
source_2_body: Activities, rules, exceptions, roles, outcomes, and pain points linked to systems.
source_3_body: Approved options, rationale, open questions, and accountable decision owners.
context_layer_intro: Connect evidence to the task through:
governance_controls: Scope • source links • versions • approvals • permissions • uncertainty
task_1_body: Draft alternatives from observed behavior, constraints, and target outcomes.
task_2_body: Draft traceable stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases from validated evidence.
task_3_body: Provide relevant rules, dependencies, and approved design decisions to delivery teams.
task_4_body: Derive tests from known states, controls, exceptions, and acceptance criteria.
takeaway: Retrieve task-relevant context with source links; people remain accountable for review, testing, and release decisions.
